sci-repo-y10-aran-2016-chem2gen-mc-1.coverage: Original assessment questions with source figures. Written parts remain in the bank with marks and parent context. Review-required items excluded from automatic battles.

options: An element with incomplete outer valence shells.
A pure substance made up of only one type of atom.
A particle with a neutral charge.
questions.explanation: A charged particle;in this atomic-ion context an atom/group with net electric charge.

questions.prompt: An atom that loses electrons to become an ion has a:
questions.explanation: Loss of negative electrons leaves a positive ion.

questions.prompt: The chemical formula for boron oxide is:
The general name for the chemicals that take part in a chemical reaction is:
Choose the equation that is not balanced.
questions.explanation: A is not balanced:5carbon atoms on left versus1on right,and oxygen totals also differ. Balanced pentane combustion:C₅H₁₂+8O₂→5CO₂+6H₂O. SourceHCLmeansHCl.

questions.prompt: Which of the following only contains diatomic gasses?
options: Oxygen gas, methane and chlorine gas.
Nitrogen gas, chlorine gas, methane and Helium gas.
Nitrogen gas, chlorine gas, oxygen gas and hydrogen gas.
Methane, helium gas, barium nitrate and hydrogen gas.

questions.prompt: A written or formula statement that shows the reactant and products in a chemical reaction is called a:
questions.explanation: A chemical equation represents reactants and products.

questions.prompt: Which of the following contains only acids?
questions.explanation: C contains hydrochloric,sulfuric and phosphoric acids;other rows include hydroxide/carbonate bases.
